hebrewText: כֵּ֤ן אֲזַמְּרָ֣ה שִׁמְ/ךָ֣ לָ/עַ֑ד לְֽ/שַׁלְּמִ֥/י נְדָרַ֗/י י֣וֹם יֽוֹם

tokens.bdb: properly, set upright; hence (figuratively as adjective) just; but usually (as adverb or conjunction) rightly or so (in various applications to manner, time and relation; often with other particles)
tokens.kjv: [phrase] after that (this, -ward, -wards), as... as, [phrase] (for-) asmuch as yet, [phrase] be (for which) cause, [phrase] following, howbeit, in (the) like (manner, -wise), [idiom] the more, right, (even) so, state, straightway, such (thing), surely, [phrase] there (where) -fore, this, thus, true, well, [idiom] you.

tokens.bdb: play upon it; to make music, accompanied by the voice; hence to celebrate in song and music
tokens.kjv: give praise, sing forth praises, psalms.
tokens.ptLiteralWord: play upon it; to make music
tokens.enLiteralWord: play upon it; to make music
tokens.explanation: play upon it; to make music
tokens.explanationEn: play upon it; to make music

tokens.bdb: an appellation, as amark or memorial of individuality; by implication honor, authority, character
properly, a (peremptory) terminus, i.e. (by implication) duration, in the sense of advance or perpetuity (substantially as a noun, either with or without a preposition)
tokens.kjv: eternity, ever(-lasting, -more), old, perpetually, [phrase] world without end.

tokens.bdb: to be safe (in mind, body or estate); figuratively, to be (causatively, make) completed; by implication, to be friendly; by extension, to reciprocate (in various applications)
tokens.kjv: make amends, (make an) end, finish, full, give again, make good, (re-) pay (again), (make) (to) (be at) peace(-able), that is perfect, perform, (make) prosper(-ous), recompense, render, requite, make restitution, restore, reward, [idiom] surely.

tokens.bdb: a promise (to God); also (concretely) a thing promised
tokens.ptLiteralWord: a promise ; also  a thing promised
tokens.enLiteralWord: a promise ; also  a thing promised
tokens.explanation: a promise ; also  a thing promised
tokens.explanationEn: a promise ; also  a thing promised

tokens.bdb: a day (as the warm hours), whether literal (from sunrise to sunset, or from one sunset to the next), or figurative (a space of time defined by an associated term), (often used adverb)
tokens.kjv: age, [phrase] always, [phrase] chronicals, continually(-ance), daily, ((birth-), each, to) day, (now a, two) days (agone), [phrase] elder, [idiom] end, [phrase] evening, [phrase] (for) ever(-lasting, -more), [idiom] full, life, as (so) long as (... live), (even) now, [phrase] old, [phrase] outlived, [phrase] perpetually, presently, [phrase] remaineth, [idiom] required, season, [idiom] since, space, then, (process of) time, [phrase] as at other times, [phrase] in trouble, weather, (as) when, (a, the, within a) while (that), [idiom] whole ([phrase] age), (full) year(-ly), [phrase] younger.
